script_text: Libra, brace — this week the Full Moon in your sign hits like a cosmic spotlight, igniting your 7th House of partnerships with a Sun-Moon opposition. Early this week, Venus, your ruling planet and the heart of your air element, squares Saturn, pulling old relationship fears to the surface. Monday is overthinking day; Tuesday feels still very heavy, so avoid decisions. Then midweek, shift arrives: Mercury enters Libra, your diplomatic sign, and words carry new power. Late week, communication turns magnetic, and really love or career clarity may finally land in your 10th House. This weekend, Full Moon lingers, amplifying your values and desires. Wednesday is your power day because Mercury enters your 7th House, forcing honest conversations that heal bonds. Monday is your worst day because the Full Moon opposition peaks emotionally. Weekly advice: release one loyalty test you’ve been avoiding. Follow for daily updates.
